data.title: Zhongguancun Science-Tech Leasing Signs RMB49 Million Finance Lease Deal
data.description:
Zhongguancun Science-Tech Leasing Co. Ltd. Class H ( (HK:1601) ) has shared an announcement.

Zhongguancun Science-Tech Leasing Co., Ltd. has entered into a finance lease agreement under which it will purchase thermoforming-related production assets, including laser cutting machines, from an independent PRC automotive lightweight products maker for RMB49 million. The assets, with a net book value of about RMB56.24 million, will then be leased back to the same company for 36 months.

Over the three-year term, the lessee will pay total finance lease installments of approximately RMB54.38 million, comprising a RMB49 million principal and RMB5.38 million in interest income inclusive of VAT, settled quarterly. Classified as a discloseable transaction under Hong Kong’s Listing Rules, the deal reflects Zhongguancun Science-Tech Leasing’s continued deployment of working capital into asset-backed leasing and supports the manufacturing client’s liquidity while preserving long-term access to critical production equipment.

data.title: Shanghai Bio-heart Strikes Strategic Pact to Commercialise Bioabsorbable Coronary Stent
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Shanghai Bio-Heart Biological Technology Co., Ltd. Class H ( (HK:2185) ).

Shanghai Bio-heart Biological Technology Co., Ltd. has signed a strategic cooperation agreement with Shanghai Shenqi Medical Technology Co., Ltd. to jointly advance the commercialisation and clinical application of its BioHeart bioabsorbable rapamycin-eluting coronary stent system. The pact will tap Shenqi Medical’s established cardiovascular market channels and academic promotion capabilities to broaden adoption of the stent among coronary heart disease patients.

Under the agreement, both parties will integrate innovative device technology with professional market service resources to promote clinical popularisation and standardised use of the BioHeart stent as an interventional option without permanent implantation. The board views this cooperation as a key step in accelerating product market penetration, strengthening the company’s business development strategy and delivering benefits to its overall shareholder base.
